categories.main_business_segments: Sidea Semiconductor Equipment (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor-specific equipment, focusing on probe testing technology. Its main products include wafer probers, die probers, sorting machines, exposure machines, and AOI inspection equipment, serving integrated circuits, optoelectronic chips, discrete devices, and third-generation compound semiconductors manufacturing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core probe testing technologies such as high-precision fast-response large-stroke precision stepping, coordinated positioning control, automatic probe card alignment, wafer automatic loading/unloading, intelligent algorithm-based machine vision, and electromagnetic compatibility design. It employs autonomous R&D with a structured process involving project initiation, implementation, validation, and closure, supported by ISO9001:2015 quality management and a combination of in-house production and outsourced custom processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic semiconductor manufacturers such as HuaCan Optoelectronics, Zhaochi, Silan Microelectronics, Qianzhao Optoelectronics, and Jucan Optoelectronics. The company serves semiconductor wafer manufacturers, packaging and testing firms, optoelectronic device producers, discrete device manufacturers, and sensor producers, with a strong presence in the Chinese mainland market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Shenzhen and a branch in Wuxi. Its sales are predominantly domestic, with over 99% of revenue generated within China, and limited overseas sales. It benefits from geographic proximity to the rapidly growing Chinese semiconductor industry.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sidea Semiconductor Equipment operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in semiconductor testing equipment used during wafer fabrication and chip testing stages. It provides critical equipment for wafer probing and die testing, essential for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous autonomous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on high-end semiconductor detection technologies and expanding its product line to include advanced probe testing and related semiconductor test equipment. It plans to deepen supply chain collaboration, enhance cost-efficiency through smart design and manufacturing, and build a strong talent pipeline to sustain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor testing equipment, including wafer probers, die probers, sorting machines, exposure machines, and AOI inspection devices. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some agency sales, recognizing revenue upon customer acceptance and equipment installation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor testing equipment market is dominated by foreign leaders such as Advantest, Kokusai, Teradyne, Tokyo Electron, and Tokyo Seimitsu. Sidea holds a leading domestic position with approximately 23.3% market share in China’s probe station segment as of mid-2024, ranking first among domestic manufacturers and steadily increasing its market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 508 million, a slight decrease of 7.06% from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 91.87 million, a 2.97% increase year-over-year. The company maintains a stable financial scale with positive cash flow improvements and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a 13.41% revenue ratio for R&D expenses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sidea differentiates itself through its comprehensive product coverage from 4-inch to 12-inch wafer probers, advanced probe testing core technologies that have broken foreign monopolies, and strong localization advantages. It offers high-precision, automated, and intelligent testing solutions tailored to domestic semiconductor manufacturers, supported by responsive local service and a robust innovation ecosystem.
